procedure: Choose peers and economically relevant metrics.
Align dates, calendars, definitions, ownership and claims.
Calculate comparable multiples and eligible-population statistics.
Explain dispersion, selected interpretation and dependence on other methods.

acceptance.expectation: Inclusion/exclusion and selected multiple are defensible for the target unit and claim.
EV/equity numerators match denominators, dates, leases, NCI and currency basis.
Undefined or missing values are not zero-filled or included silently in statistics.
Method divergence and shared dependencies are disclosed; no automatic averaging.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction

artifact_alias_semantics: Logical plan output names for the corresponding method records, not extra completed artifacts. Preserve unit, current version and actual completion/review state; a design or formula specification is not an executed model or reconciled numerical bridge.
